name: local-support-assistant
description: Local-first pre-sales intake and support RAG assistant demo.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w ingestion
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend && npm run lint -w ingestion
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
